case_rules.original: Original traversal unchanged; fresh pre-hook, constructor and closeout hashes match fixed byte-fixture expected.
case_rules.alias_reordered: Six odd references first under aliases then six even references, current registry stays in that order; content hashes remain complete legacy order.
case_rules.mutation_before: After initial hash change parameter0 first float1->1.5, no metadata/version change; unchanged constructor predicate rejects.
case_rules.mutation_closeout: After constructor/native readiness change same float1->1.5 without metadata/version change; fresh candidate parameter_state content hash rejects.
case_rules.wrong_initial: Before capture first float1.5; INITIAL_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH, not automatic wrong-checkpoint proof.
case_rules.missing_reference: Pass None instead of loader retained tuple.
case_rules.replaced_object: Replace first current parameter with distinct same-byte/shape/dtype/flags/version object.
case_rules.duplicate_object: Append one occurrence of retained parameter0.
case_rules.byte_boundaries: Redistribute first two arrays [1,2],[2,3] into [1],[2,2,3], preserving concatenated bytes but changing per-object lengths/shapes.
case_rules.later_registry: Reverse current registry after construction; legacy content still hashes correctly but unchanged current name/order/identity check rejects.
